ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……拜托了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
今天我也，一直觉得很害怕，
但我仿佛感到你对我说了……加油

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我是高松灯。
请多指教……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小爱音，给你这个……喝点水……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
向小爽世道歉……虽然我不知道该不该道歉，
但是，我确实伤害了她……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊……那个……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小，小祥……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 千早……同学

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……你真的……要退出吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 可是，要是你退出的话——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
那时……我没有把歌唱好。
害得乐队四分五裂

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我好难受，好难受，
我已经不想再经历这种事了……
还觉得以后……再也不想组乐队了……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……去小爽世那边

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……为什么，要带贝斯手来……？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 那个……我找到了一块、漂亮的石头……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 奇怪……笔记本，放到哪里去了……？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 去水族馆还是星象馆好呢……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 石头下面有西瓜虫，感觉春天到了呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 天气变暖后，各种各样的生物都开始活动了呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 一打开家门，就觉得扑面而来的空气好热

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 感觉夏天来星象馆的人好多……
